title: Dominic and the Room
author: Jude Voss
blurb: Ivo Dunmore, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
